messages:
Zara: Quick economy question / sticker edition: who started the office sticker fund? :sticker:
Eli: That was Jun, circa sticker recession of 2023.
Jun: I plead guilty. I minted 12 rare cactus stickers and then hoarded them. :sweat_smile:
Pia: Proposal: micro-auction for naming rights of the new ficus. Winner gets a gold sticker and eternal bragging rights.
Zara: Auction starts at 2 stickers, 30s increments. Also one-liner round while we wait: best plant name pun gets +1 bid credit.
Eli: "Ficus Maximus" 
Jun: "Photosynthesizzle" :fire:
Pia: "Leaf Erickson" :sailboat:
CleanerBot: Reminder: Please don't tape stickers to the espresso machine. Maintenance hates surprises.
Zara: Bidding: Eli 2 stickers, Jun 3 stickers, Pia 4 stickers. Jun drops to 3.5 (imaginary half-stickers not allowed but dramatic).
Eli: Raising to 5. I will defend my name honor.
Jun: Drops out. Moral victory is mine.
Pia: Winner: Pia with 5 stickers. Plant named Leaf Erickson. Will post a tiny plaque.
Zara: Bonus one-liner reward goes to Jun for sheer confidence. Sticker redistributed: Jun gets consolation sticker.
Eli: Also PSA: sticker trades should be logged on the sticker whiteboard (next to printer) to avoid future economies of scale.
Pia: I'll print a tiny certificate and attach a sticker to the ficus pot. Thank you, sticker council.
CleanerBot: Note: Office tidy-up Friday 5pm. Bring stickers and good humor. :broom:
